title: Reverse Proxy Path Flow
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Reverse Proxy Path Flow.
learning_objectives: Explain reverse proxy path flow using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for reverse proxy path flow
Assess failure and operational limits of reverse proxy path flow
concepts_covered: A reverse proxy forwards a request while a client uses one stable address.
ServeHTTP parses /service/path, selects an instance, removes the prefix, and forwards with NewSingleHostReverseProxy.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
